metadata.description: Controlled Language: an agent skill that writes, rewrites, and reviews technical documentation in a controlled language (English and other languages), based on the principles of ASD-STE100, at three strictness levels.

plugins.name: controlled-language
plugins.description: Write, rewrite, and review docs in a controlled language (ASD-STE100 principles). English: full rules; other languages: the same principles with language files. Levels 1 Light, 2 Standard, 3 Strict.
